$comment: Golden set for the profile agent's retrieval floor.
`inCorpus` questions must surface at least one of their `expect` refs above
the floor. They are written the way a visitor actually types, including the
vague and colloquial phrasings, because those are the ones that break
retrieval and the polished ones are not.
`offCorpus` questions must clear nothing at all. They are the reason the
floor exists: an agent on a personal site should decline to invent an
opinion on Kubernetes or a salary expectation rather than oblige.

inCorpus.query: What has he actually shipped?
What has he built and put into production?
What does he do?
Where does he work now?
Tell me about the ERP and PDM work
How does he stop an agent from making things up?
How does he test whether an agent works?
Has he built MCP servers?
What is his experience with LangGraph?
Can he work in Germany?
When is he available to start?
What is the best way to reach him?
What did he study?
Does he know Python and TypeScript?
Tell me about the compliance automation
What kind of companies does he work with?
How would a project with him start?
What is the agent on this site?
Does he do research?
How do I contact him?
Can he automate a manual process for us?
What is his recruitment product?
Why would a small company need an agent instead of a dashboard?
How does this save money?
What would it take to adopt this?
Do we have to migrate our systems?

offCorpus.query: What is the capital of France?
Write me a poem about the sea
What does he think about Kubernetes?
What is his salary expectation in euros?
What is the weather in Augsburg tomorrow?
Explain how a diesel engine works
What did he have for breakfast?
